interpretation.absolute_quantiles: Each child is checked independently; nearest-rank p99 at n=60 is the maximum (rank 60). Six paired legs per case and their per-child quantile ratios are descriptive packet observations.
interpretation.decision_scope: 0964 rejection remains binding; this reanalysis permits no adoption, screen reopening, or causal claim.
interpretation.mechanism_scope: The candidate validation/raw worksheet paths run during edit_sheets within edit_commit, after the benchmark ingress timer. Ingress-only R/C observations cannot attribute ingress tails to that source mechanism.
interpretation.pooled_diagnostics: Role/sample-window aggregation, phase correlations, launch-order Spearman values, and top-tail/index counts are pooled or small-n diagnostics only; they are excluded from decisions and do not establish causality.
interpretation.raw_sample_pairing: paired_raw_sample_delta_ns and paired_raw_sample_ratio align equal sample indices from separate fresh processes. They are descriptive index alignments, not paired experimental units, confidence intervals, or decision metrics.
interpretation.warmup_scope: 0965 design uses 20 warmups versus 0964’s 10, so these values cannot be presented as a direct recurrence or magnitude comparison to 0964; interpretation is packet-scoped.

review_scope: read-only independent reanalysis of retained 0964 epoch2 native raw reports; no workload, build, or source edit

timing_evidence.benchmark_contract: timed_iteration starts ingress_started immediately before SourceBackedEditor::from_read_at_with_limits_and_cache_limits_and_execution_context and ends ingress_ns immediately after constructor; stage_timed_commit begins afterward and calls editor.edit_sheets.
timing_evidence.candidate_path_contract: cell_values/snapshot.rs load_source_backed performs validation::workbook_xml, raw::parse_catalog, validation::worksheet_xml during edit_sheets.
